mapper.select: SELECT id, name, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM instructors WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, name, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM instructors WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instructors (name, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE instructors SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
